title: The Antwerp Diamond Heist
hook: Who vanished with more than $100 million of diamonds in minutes?
headline: The biggest heist ever pulled

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On a February night, thieves cracked the Antwerp Diamond Center vault silently.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: They disabled the alarm and cut through concrete in ten minutes.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Inside, they lifted roughly $100 million in gems, including the Pink Star precious.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Investigators later learned a former guard vanished, suspected as the mastermind himself.

end.line: What really happened that night, do you think ever?

description: A look at the daring 2003 Antwerp diamond robbery that still baffles investigators.

facts.claim: The Antwerp Diamond Center vault was breached on a February night in 2003.
Thieves disabled the 24-hour alarm and cut through a concrete wall in under ten minutes.
The stolen diamonds were valued at about $100 million, including the Pink Star.
One suspect, a former security guard, disappeared after the robbery.
The heist is considered the largest diamond theft in history.
